title: POST /api/v3/command with a nested body object causes a process-terminating stack overflow
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

On Sonarr 4.0.20.3014, `POST /api/v3/command` with a nested `"body"` object reproducibly terminates the Sonarr process with `Stack overflow.` on stderr. The client receives an empty reply; the container supervisor restarts the app process (the container/pod itself stays up).

### Expected Behavior

The request is rejected (4xx) or accepted — but the process stays up.

### Steps To Reproduce

`196` is an existing series ID in my instance. The first request terminates the process; the control request queues a real series search.

```bash
# crashes
curl -i 'http://HOST:8989/api/v3/command' \
  -H 'X-Api-Key: REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"SeriesSearch","body":{"seriesId":196}}'

# control — no crash, returns 201 (queued)
curl -i 'http://HOST:8989/api/v3/command' \
  -H 'X-Api-Key: REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"SeriesSearch","seriesId":196}'
```

Omitting `body`, or setting it to `null`, did not crash in these tests.

### Environment

- OS: Linux (k3s)
- Sonarr: 4.0.20.3014 — image `ghcr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.20.3014-ls326`
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes (also reproduces direct to `:8989`, so the proxy is not the cause)
- Database: SQLite

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs

Trace logging was not enabled at the time of the crash, and no relevant application-log entries were produced for it. The definitive artifact is the process stderr (abridged, real frames):

```
Stack overflow.
Repeat 895 times:
--------------------------------
   at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Read[[System.__Canon, ...]](...)
   at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize[[System.__Canon, ...]](...)
   at NzbDrone.Common.Serializer.PolymorphicWriteOnlyJsonConverter`1[[System.__Canon, ...]].Read(...)
   at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1[[System.__Canon, ...]].TryRead(...)
   at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1[[System.__Canon, ...]].ReadCore(...)
--------------------------------
   ... (same cycle) ...
   at System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonPropertyInfo`1[[System.__Canon, ...]].ReadJsonAndSetMember(...)
   at System.Text.Json.Serialization.Converters.ObjectDefaultConverter`1[[System.__Canon, ...]].OnTryRead(...)
   at Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Formatters.SystemTextJsonInputFormatter.ReadRequestBodyAsync(...)
```

### Anything else

Diagnosis (not a proposed fix): source inspection suggests that binding the nested `body` invokes the type-level `PolymorphicWriteOnlyJsonConverter<Command>` on the abstract `Command` type; its read implementation deserializes `Command` again with the same serializer options, apparently selecting the same converter recursively. The stack trace is consistent with this occurring during MVC model binding, before the action executes. The top-level form succeeds; the nested form is included only to reproduce the crash.

Source (release-tagged):
- converter: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/v4.0.20.3014/src/NzbDrone.Common/Serializer/System.Text.Json/PolymorphicWriteOnlyJsonConverter.cs
- `Command` attribute: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/v4.0.20.3014/src/NzbDrone.Core/Messaging/Commands/Command.cs
- controller: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/v4.0.20.3014/src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Commands/CommandController.cs

Related: #8953 (closed with a request to use the issue template). Same defect reproduced on Radarr 6.4.4.10685.
